summary: MLX-Audio is a text-to-speech (TTS), speech-to-text (STT) and speech-to-speech (STS) library built on Apple's MLX framework.
It provides efficient speech analysis on Apple Silicon with capabilities for TTS, STT, and STS.
The library includes a modern web interface and OpenAI-compatible API.
MLX-Audio supports quantization to reduce model size and improve performance.
It requires Python 3.10+, Apple Silicon Mac (M1/M2/M3/M4), MLX framework, and ffmpeg for audio encoding.

Czkawka is a free, open-source tool to find and remove unnecessary files from your computer.
It has two frontends: Czkawka GTK and Krokiet GUI, both written in Rust.
The tool supports multiple languages and has various features such as duplicate finder, empty folders, big files, etc.
Czkawka is compared to other similar applications like DupeGuru, FSlint, AntiDupl.NET, etc.
It exposes its common functionality through a crate called czkawka_core, which can be reused by other projects.
UltraRAG v3 is a low-code MCP framework for building complex RAG pipelines.
It provides a unified evaluation system, research efficiency, and rapid interactive prototype generation.
The framework is designed for researchers and industrial prototyping, with a focus on precision orchestration of control structures.
UltraRAG supports inference orchestration, modular extension, and reproduction, as well as one-click delivery of pipeline logic to interactive conversational Web UIs.
It offers various installation methods, including local source code installation and Docker container deployment, and provides tutorials for beginners and advanced users.
VibeVoice is a family of open-source frontier voice AI models including Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models.
The VibeVoice-ASR model can handle 60-minute long-form audio in a single pass, generating structured transcriptions with speaker information and timestamps.
VibeVoice-TTS supports up to 4 distinct speakers and can synthesize speech up to 90 minutes in length.
VibeVoice-Realtime is a lightweight real-time TTS model supporting streaming text input and robust long-form speech generation.
The models are designed for research and development purposes only, and users are expected to use them responsibly.

Supermemory is an AI-powered memory engine and app designed to be extremely fast and scalable.
The platform allows users to add memories from various sources, including URLs, PDFs, and plain text, and converse with their stored content using natural language chat.
It seamlessly connects with major AI tools via the Supermemory MCP Integration, and offers a browser extension for saving memories directly from webpages.
Supermemory also features a Raycast extension for adding and searching memories directly from the development environment.
The platform is open-source, and contributors are welcome to fix bugs, add features, or improve documentation.
DCCast: Efficient Point to Multipoint Transfers Across Datacenters
A centralized Point to Multi-Point (P2MP) algorithm that uses forwarding trees to efficiently deliver objects from a source datacenter to required destination datacenters.

Simulation experiments on Google's GScale network show that DCCast can reduce total bandwidth usage and tail Transfer Completion Times (TCT) by up to 50% compared to independent point-to-point transfers.
The algorithm minimizes bandwidth usage and balances load across all links with low computational overhead.
DCCast is a solution for cloud providers to distribute multiple copies of data efficiently across multiple datacenters.

SIS is a security lens for rule-based systems.
It's designed for static, pre-deployment analysis of rule and policy configurations.

SIS offers deterministic rules, stateless API, multi-format support, sealed logic, and a quick start guide.
It provides a free security audit, compliance dashboard, CI/CD pipeline, and is production-ready
The paper analyzes vulnerabilities in MIFARE Ultralight C and AES-protected NFC technologies.
Attackers can reduce keyspace of 2TDEA from $2^{112}$ to $2^{28}$ or less through relay-based man-in-the-middle techniques and partial key overwrites.
MIFARE Ultralight AES protocol can be affected when CMAC integrity checks are not enforced.
NTAG 223 DNA and NTAG 224 DNA security is undermined by absence of integrity checks on commands and calculation of CMAC over SUN messages.
Proper configuration, key diversification, and counterfeit detection are urgently needed in NFC deployments.

VibeVoice-ASR is a unified speech-to-text model that can process up to 60-minute long-form audio in a single pass.
The model generates structured transcriptions containing Who (Speaker), When (Timestamps), and What (Content).
It supports Customized Hotwords, which significantly improves accuracy on domain-specific content.
VibeVoice-ASR accepts continuous audio input within 64K token length, ensuring consistent speaker tracking and semantic coherence across the entire hour.
The model is licensed under the MIT License and can be deployed using Inference Providers

Unredacted is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization that builds Internet infrastructure and services to help people evade censorship and protect their right to privacy.
The organization focuses on three main areas: Privacy, Censorship Evasion, and Education.
It provides various services such as Tor Relays & Bridges, Secure Infrastructure (SI), Unredacted Proxies, and community support.
Unredacted is committed to transparency and security, with a privacy-by-default approach to its projects and services.
The organization is open-source and licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.

Passive House is a building standard that is truly energy efficient, comfortable and affordable at the same time.
Passive House buildings allow for space heating and cooling related energy savings of up to 90% compared with typical building stock and over 75% compared to average new builds.
Passive House buildings use less than 1.5 l of oil or 1.5 m3   of gas to heat one square meter of living space for a year.
Passive House buildings make efficient use of the sun, internal heat sources and heat recovery, rendering conventional heating systems unnecessary throughout even the coldest of winters.
A ventilation system imperceptibly supplies constant fresh air, making for superior air quality without unpleasant draughts.
